target.statement: On the management collection (2,004 documents), the two layers carry largely complementary information: 7.4% of neighbour pairs are neighbours in both layers, and the correlation between the two similarities on random pairs is 0.17.
target.dataset: Management collection: 2,063 WoS articles (1985-2025) using bibliometric/scientometric methods in management; 2,004 analysed

compute.basis: Paper reports the full pipeline (layers, null model with B=99 curveball randomisations, QAP, consensus clustering) runs in ~29 s on 2,000 documents on a 14-core M4 Pro; on 8 CPU cores expect a few minutes of compute, dominated by installing R/bibliometrix and loading the bundled dataset.

blockers: Keyword cleaning lists (synonyms/remove.terms) are in the replication material but the exact cleaned topic layer may differ slightly, shifting the 7.4%/0.17 numbers
Development branch of bibliometrix must be installed from GitHub; may be outdated or moved
Root naming optionally queries OpenAlex API (not needed for this target)
title: Multiplex coupling: Connecting the intellectual base and the topics of a research field
